name: fortinet-fortimanager-json-rpc
label: Fortinet FortiManager JSON RPC
description: The Fortinet FortiManager JSON RPC Connector is an advanced connector with freeform actions to use the JSON-RPC API directly. This connector puts the onus on the user to understand the FortiManager API. To use the connector that simplify actions please see the original Fortinet FortiManager Connector.

fields.name: address
fields.title: Hostname
fields.tooltip: Provide the IP address or Hostname of the FortiManager endpoint server to which you will connect
fields.description: IP address or Hostname of the Fortinet FortiManager endpoint server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: Authentication Method
fields.name: auth_method
fields.description: Select the method using which you will authenticate to the Fortinet FortiManager server.

Username/Password.name: username
Username/Password.title: Username
Username/Password.description: Username with JSON-RPC enabled to access the Fortinet FortiManager server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

Username/Password.name: password
Username/Password.title: Password
Username/Password.description: Password to access the Fortinet FortiManager server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

API Key.title: API Key
API Key.name: api_key
API Key.description: API key to access the Fortinet FortiManager server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.name: port
fields.title: Port
fields.description: Port number used to access the Fortinet FortiManager server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations. By default, this is set to 443.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.

fields.name: debug_connection
fields.title: Debug Connection
fields.description: Only used with the json_rpc connections, and enables the debug. This can sometimes cause an I/O operation error since debugging involves printing responses, which writes to the integration.log file.

fields.name: verbose_json
fields.title: Verbose JSON
fields.description: Setting this to true adds a verbose flag to the request, so that the integers are translated to the string representation by FortiManager.

operations.title: Get FortiManager Device Stats
operations.description: Gather comprehensive FortiManager device statistics including device details, firewall policies, policy statistics, and optional resource usage (CPU/Memory)

parameters.name: adom
parameters.title: ADOM
parameters.description: ADOM to query. Leave empty to query all ADOMs.

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.title: VDOM
parameters.description: VDOM to query for policies. Default is 'root'.

parameters.name: device_filter
parameters.title: Device Filter
parameters.description: Filter criteria for devices. Example: [["os_type","==","fos"],"&&",["conn_status","==","up"]]

parameters.name: device_fields
parameters.title: Device Fields
parameters.description: List of device fields to retrieve. Leave empty for default fields.

parameters.name: device_options
parameters.title: Device Options
parameters.description: List of device options. Example: ["extra info","assignment info","get meta","loadsub"]

parameters.name: include_policies
parameters.title: Include Policies
parameters.description: Include firewall policies in the output. Default is true.

parameters.name: include_policy_stats
parameters.title: Include Policy Stats
parameters.description: Include firewall policy statistics in the output. Default is true.

parameters.name: merge_stats
parameters.title: Merge Stats with Policies
parameters.description: Merge policy statistics with policy data. Default is true.

parameters.name: include_policy_target
parameters.title: Include Policy Target
parameters.description: Include firewall policy target in the Policy output. Default is true.

parameters.name: include_uptime
parameters.title: Include Uptime
parameters.description: Include FortiManager system uptime in the output. Default is false.

parameters.name: policy_fields
parameters.title: Policy Fields
parameters.description: List of policy fields to retrieve. Example: ["policyid","name","srcintf","dstintf","action"]. Leave empty for default fields.

parameters.name: stat_fields
parameters.title: Stat Fields
parameters.description: List of stat fields to retrieve. Example: ["policyid","bytes","packets","hit_count","last_used"]. Leave empty for default fields.

parameters.name: include_resource_usage
parameters.title: Include Resource Usage
parameters.description: Include system resource usage (CPU/Memory) data. Default is false.

parameters.name: resource_summary_mode
parameters.title: Resource Summary Mode
parameters.description: How to summarize resource data

parameters.name: resource_metrics
parameters.title: Resource Metrics
parameters.description: List of metrics to include

parameters.name: resource_time_windows
parameters.title: Resource Time Windows
parameters.description: List of time windows to include

parameters.name: additional_calls
parameters.title: Additional Calls
parameters.description: Optional list of custom sys/proxy/json calls to query for each target. Each call should be a dict: {"url": "...", "return_key": "...", "action": "...", "data": {...}}. Example: [{"url": "/api/v2/monitor/system/resource/usage", "return_key": "resource_usage"}]

parameters.name: url
parameters.title: URL
parameters.description: The GUI endpoint URL (e.g., /gui/sys/uptime)

parameters.name: data
parameters.title: Data
parameters.description: Optional parameters to send with the request

operations.title: Get Device Vulnerabilities
operations.description: Retrieve PSIRT vulnerability information for devices in an ADOM with optional filtering

parameters.name: adom_oid
parameters.title: ADOM OID
parameters.description: The ADOM ID (OID) to retrieve vulnerabilities for

parameters.name: fortios_only
parameters.title: FortiOS Only
parameters.description: Return only FortiOS vulnerability information (excludes FortiProxy, FortiSASE, etc.)

parameters.name: simplify
parameters.title: Simplify Response
parameters.description: Return simplified vulnerability data (IR number, CVE, title, severity, CVSS score, description, products)

parameters.name: exclude_impacted_versions
parameters.title: Exclude Impacted Versions
parameters.description: Exclude the impacted version list (when unchecked, converts to simple version strings like ['7.6.0', '7.4.7'])

parameters.name: severity_filter
parameters.title: Severity Filter
parameters.description: Filter vulnerabilities by severity level
